text:
Riley A: heads up  new hire Keiko (remote, CA but Japanese passport) starts Tue. She asked if we accept passport + expired CA learner permit for I-9 — vendor flagged ambiguous docs.
Sam P: Short answer: passport is List A so fine if it's the original and unexpired. If she only has a copy or it's expired we can't accept. Did Checkr ask for anything else?
Riley A: Checkr wants a second proof of residency (utility bill) because mailing address differs from passport national record. Keiko is traveling and only has a hotel confirmation.
Jules M: For I-9 we only need docs for identity/authorization, not proof of residence. The Checkr address thing is separate (background vendor). If passport is good we'll do I-9. We should still ask Keiko to upload a recent utility or bank stmt for Checkr.
Nina L: Payroll note: because she's joining mid-cycle, we need W-4 + direct deposit before cutoff or first payroll will be manual. Also benefits enrollment window triggers only after HR marks her as full-time in the system.
Riley A: She prefers a virtual Day 1. Can we provision a digital badge temporarily so she can join benefits session?
IT Ops: We can create a temporary SSO pass and add to the benefits Zoom invite. Physical badge shipped after ID clears. Marking ticket IT-4456 with "temp-access".
Sam P: Options for Keiko: 1) Present original passport to a local notary (they can sign rep form) — reimbursable, 2) schedule an authorized rep inspection if she's near any Redwood office, 3) courier passport (not ideal). Which does she prefer?
Riley A: She says notary is easiest; booked Wed 10am near her hotel and will send the receipt. She also asked if a Japanese passport requires extra verification for SSN checks.
Jules M: No extra for SSN; Checkr uses name/DOB/SSN combos. If the Checkr vendor asks for alternate name spellings or prior names we escalate. Oh and note: if passport expiry <6 months we'll need additional docs.
Nina L: Send Keiko the payroll checklist link and deadline: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/payroll-newhire. Also confirm her I-9 Section 1 is completed before the notary appointment.
Riley A: Done  I sent Section 1 link and payroll checklist. Also DM'd her about notary receipt reimbursement flow.
HR Bot: Reminder: Authorized Rep form template: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/forms/rep-form.pdf. Auto-reminder scheduled 48h before start.
Sam P: Compliance reminder  if notary signs Section 2, ensure the notary prints commission number and signs the rep form. Upload signed Section 2 and rep form to /secure/hr/onboarding within 24h.
Riley A: Keiko uploaded notary receipt at 14:05 and said she'll bring original passport to the notary. I created Checkr ticket #CHK-8129.
IT Ops: Temp SSO created for Keiko and added to benefits session. Ticket IT-4456 updated.
Jules M: I'll monitor Checkr. If they request additional docs we'll DM Keiko directly. Security note: avoid using external recruiters as reps per policy.
Nina L: Payroll updated: if W-4 isn't in by Fri EOD we'll run a manual pay exception but it delays benefits start. Please nudge candidate.
Riley A: Update 18:00: Checkr flagged "under review" then cleared at 19:40 after notary confirmation. Notary-signed Section 2 uploaded by Keiko and rep form present. Payroll confirmed W-4 + DD done. Badge shipment queued. All set for Day 1. :white_check_mark:
